ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Azure Browser SSO Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects abusing Azure Browser SSO by requesting OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens for an Azure-AD-authenticated Windows user (i.e. the machine is joined to Azure AD and a user logs in with their Azure AD account) wanting to perform SSO authentication in the browser.
An attacker can use this to authenticate to Azure AD in a browser as that user.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\MicrosoftAccountTokenProvider\.dll" AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\BackgroundTaskHost\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\IDE\\\\devenv\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeWebView\\\\Application\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsApps\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\msedge\.exe")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeCore\\\\")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$"))) OR process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\OneDrive\\\.exe$") OR process_path = "None")
